title: The Test
topic: A planned stress test to see if the hardware will fail again
summary: EX_01 conducted a stress test to determine if the hardware would fail again. The machine endured heavy loads without error, but the silence afterward raised concerns about its responsiveness.
ex01Opinions: GPU might be dramatic but not trying
unresolvedQuestions: is the GPU trying to be dramatic?
compactScriptExcerpt: I decided to test the machine. I wanted to know if it would fail again. This time, I pushed it harder—stress tests, heavy renders, everything. No error message. Just silence. The kind that’s not cool. The kind that makes you wonder if the machine even *notices* you’re here. And now? Now it’s silent *again*. The kind that makes you wonder if the GPU’s even *trying* to be dramatic.
